data.description: Typed block payload. Plain-text fields are rendered literally, so markdown syntax written into one reaches the reader as raw characters — a heading of "**Title**" publishes with the asterisks showing. Only the fields listed as markdown are parsed. A markdown field also requires editor_mode alongside it: "rich" for prose the visual editor can handle, "source" for tables or raw HTML. Asset IDs and delivery URLs belong in the block media array, never in data. Fields by block type — heading block: literal — text. Also level (one of 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6). markdown block: parsed as markdown — markdown. Also editor_mode (one of rich, source). image block: literal — caption. gallery block: literal — caption. faq block: literal — title. Also source (one of page_qa, organization_qa). how_to block: literal — title, label, estimated_time, tool_items.*, supply_items.*, steps.*.name, steps.*.text. divider block: no text fields. cta block: literal — title, accent, description, label, secondary_label. Also url (url), secondary_url (url). contact_cta block: literal — title, accent, description, label, secondary_label. Also url (url), secondary_url (url). booking_cta block: literal — title, accent, description, label, secondary_label, price_line, notice. Also url (url), secondary_url (url). callout block: literal — title, body, badge, buttons.*.label. Also tone (one of neutral, info, success, warning, danger). hero block: literal — title, accent, eyebrow, subtitle, cta_label, secondary_label. Also cta_url (url), secondary_url (url). button_group block: literal — buttons.*.label. feature_grid block: literal — title, description, items.*.title, items.*.description, items.*.value, items.*.label, cta_label; parsed as markdown — items.*.body. Also source (one of manual, organization_posts, organization_updates, calculator, billing_plans), cta_url (url). comparison block: literal — title, description, problem_title, problem_label, problem_items.*.title, problem_items.*.description, solution_title, solution_label, solution_items.*.title, solution_items.*.description. stat_grid block: literal — title, description, label, items.*.value, items.*.title. workflow_grid block: literal — title, description, label, items.*.title, items.*.prompt, items.*.description. video_feature block: literal — title, description, video_title, items.*.title, items.*.description. Also video_url (url). media_text block: literal — title, body, label. Also url (url). contact_form block: no text fields. team_grid block: literal — title, description, items.*.first_name, items.*.last_name, items.*.title, items.*.bio. testimonial_grid block: literal — title, description. donation_choices block: literal — title, description, tiers.*.title, tiers.*.description. Also destination (url). page_grid block: literal — title, accent, description. Also page_ids (page ids). product_grid block: literal — title, description. Also collection_id (collection ids), product_ids (product ids). location_grid block: literal — title, description. Also location_ids (location ids). ai_assistance block: literal — label, intro, prompts.*.title, prompts.*.prompt, prompts.*.description, prompts.*.copy_label.

active.description: Enable or disable sale of this product. Independent of site and location publication.

marketing_features.description: Generic selling bullets. Inclusions, preparation instructions and policies are separate metafields.

metadata.description: Opaque string annotations for integrations. No pricing, scheduling, stock or filtering behavior may read these.

metafields.description: Complete replacement map keyed by "<namespace>.<key>"; preserve all entries you want to keep. Remove an entry to clear its value; use {} when no entries remain, never null values. For a literal price such as "Market price", set "pricing.note" to the exact user-provided text and send empty prices arrays for every variant. Numeric prices and pricing.note are mutually exclusive; clear pricing.note when adding numeric prices. Text-only prices display publicly but cannot be checked out. The definition must already exist; create it with create_metafield_definition.

order_url.description: A narrow ordering destination such as a delivery partner. Not the public product page.

unit_label.description: A unit noun such as "person" or "night". Never pricing prose.

variants.description: Omit to create a single default variant. Required once the product has options.

items.description: One buyable configuration. A product with no options still has exactly one. Keep the id when editing: a variant that keeps its id keeps its bookings.

option_values.description: Option id to option value id. Every option must be answered exactly once, and no two variants may answer identically.

items.description: A monetary offer on this variant. unit_amount is an integer in the currency smallest unit; 0 is an explicit free offer, and a variant with no price is not purchasable rather than free. Billing recurrence describes when the customer is charged, never when a class runs.

location_id.description: Scope this offer to one location, or null for every location the product is offered at.

active.description: The merchant sale switch. Not visibility and not stock: a disabled product is not sold out.

location_id.description: The location this offer applies at, or null for a location-neutral offer. Null is a declared scope, not a missing value.

unit_amount.description: Integer amount in the currency smallest unit.

collection.description: KrabiClaw's own site only: which collection the article belongs to. Every other site has one blog.

content_blocks.description: The article, in order. Any number of blocks of any type, images wherever they belong. The first block, when it is an image, is the cover.
